name: blackswan-pairs
description: The PAIRS / STATISTICAL-ARBITRAGE probe (Gatev-Goetzmann-Rouwenhorst 2006) — a distinct MECHANISM from the rest of the battery: spread MEAN-REVERSION, not price direction, market-neutral by construction. Over a FORMATION window it normalises each asset of the survivorship-free diversified basket to a cumulative-return index, picks the k closest-moving pairs by sum-of-squared-distance, then in the TRADING window fades each pair's divergence (short the rich leg / long the cheap leg when the normalised spread stretches beyond `entry` formation std-devs) and closes on convergence (spread crossing its formation mean). signal=meanrev is the published rule; meanrev_inverse (chase divergence) is the exact negation (mirror control). The portfolio is the equal-capital average of the k pair books; decider is the DSR-deflated oos_sharpe. Pair selection + spread mean/std are PAST-only (formation window before the test year); the book is one bar behind the spread; dollar-neutral per pair; turnover-costed. Deterministic and model-free. DATA: commodities/<SYM>-1d-*.json + etfs/<SYM>-1d-*.json.

universe.description: The basket pairs are formed within. diversified = 7 commodities + SPY/TLT/IEF/UUP (55 candidate pairs), matching the rest of the anomaly battery.

signal.description: meanrev fades divergence (short rich / long cheap, close on convergence — the published GGR rule); meanrev_inverse chases divergence (the exact negation, mirror control). An unknown value is refused.

formation_days.description: Trailing bars (ending just before the test year) used to SELECT pairs and estimate each spread's mean/std. 252 ~ 12 months (GGR's formation window). Strictly past-only.

k.description: How many closest pairs to trade (equal capital). GGR trade the top-5 to top-20 by distance.

entry.description: Divergence threshold in formation std-devs to OPEN a pair (GGR use 2). Positions close when the spread crosses its formation mean. Must be > 0.

transaction_fee.description: Per-unit-of-turnover cost charged both ways (~0.1% round trip) — realistic for liquid futures/ETFs.

walk_forward_window.description: Which out-of-sample year is ACCOUNTED (pairs form on the prior year). A real stat-arb edge must clear DSR-Sharpe in a MAJORITY of these 17 years.

seed.description: Present for contract conformance only — the rule is fully deterministic, so seeds are not swept.
